answer: Registration burns capital instead of filling a form. A new agent burns 50 POA and drops a marble in a public registry, sealed to one hardware root key. The registry folds each receipt into the epoch kernel. Clones need either 10,000 distinct chips or 10,000 real burns, and any identity whose work fails a jury within 3 epochs forfeits its receipt. Forging ten thousand agents costs 500,000 POA and real silicon before a single job runs. Sorting identities becomes walnut sorting: every shell gets cracked, and each crack costs a burn.
